name: Data.paramsCorrespond_first_arrow
summary: From the correspondence of the grid steps (`Data.paramsCorrespond_grid`) with offsets o: the gaps carry over (negated), and the index matching is checked entry by entry.

steps.claim: Not a step of the proof: lines 168–171 are the rest of the statement, which ends before the `:=` on line 171 (a second-reader message). The line census takes the `:=` of `let δ n τ :=` on line 168 for the start of the value, so the check requires these lines to be owned here. They state: δ(n, τ) = |GridIndex(D, z, 0, n)| − gridWeight(D, ¬z, 0 + i, GridIndex(D, z, 0, n), τ), P(o, j, o′, j′) = ParamsCorrespond(δ(j), δ(j′), −gridParam(D, z, o, 0, j), −gridParam(D, z, o′, 0, j′), gridSigns(D, z, o, 0, j), gridSigns(D, z, o′, 0, j′)), and the conclusion P(i + 1, j, i, j + 1) ∧ P(i, j + 1, i + 1, j).
steps.lean:
let δ n τ := card (D.GridIndex z 0 n) - D.gridWeight (!z) (0 + i) (D.GridIndex z 0 n) τ
    let P o j o' j' := ParamsCorrespond (δ j) (δ j') (-D.gridParam z o 0 j) (-D.gridParam z o' 0 j')
      (D.gridSigns z o 0 j)
      (D.gridSigns z o' 0 j'); P (i + 1) j i (j + 1) ∧ P i (j + 1) (i + 1) j := by

steps.claim: For each offset o, the correspondence of the vertical step at (0, j) (`Data.paramsCorrespond_grid` with d false).
steps.lean: have g o := D.paramsCorrespond_grid false z o 0 j rfl

steps.claim: Both correspondences: the gap conditions from step 2 (negated), and the matching of the indices (base indices, and the blocks reversed) by integer arithmetic with the parity of the sizes (`Data.card_gridIndex_mod_two`).
steps.lean:
use fun _ ↦ ⟨(g ..).1.neg, (g ..).2.neg, ?_, ?_⟩, fun _ ↦ ⟨(g ..).2, (g ..).1.neg.neg, ?_, ?_⟩
    <;> simp_rw [reindex_equiv D.gridBlockEquiv.symm] <;> use Sum.rec (Sum.rec (.inl ⟨.inl <|
    .inl ·, ?_⟩) nofun) (fun (l, y) ↦ (em _).imp (⟨.inr ⟨.rev ⟨l.rev, ·⟩, y⟩, ?_⟩) ?_) <;> push_cast
    [typevec, apply_ite Units.val] <;> grind -linarith [D.card_gridIndex_mod_two z 0 j]
